g.text: Gate: diode to the control line (-12 V hold, +12 V sample), 100k to the drain. Droop about 3 mV/s (op-amp bias into 8.8 nF).

g.desc: Gate: diode to the control line (-12 V hold, +12 V sample), 100k to the drain. Droop about 3 mV/s (op-amp bias into 8.8 nF).

g.text: Panel: J1 IN, J2 IN NORM, J3 TRIG, J4 TRIG NORM (the jacks' switch contacts carry IN_SNH / TRIG_SNH), J5 OUT, J6 LED; J7 MODE (up TRACK: shorts C8).

g.desc: Panel: J1 IN, J2 IN NORM, J3 TRIG, J4 TRIG NORM (the jacks' switch contacts carry IN_SNH / TRIG_SNH), J5 OUT, J6 LED; J7 MODE (up TRACK: shorts C8).

g.text: snh: IN x-0.47 -> JFET switch -> 4 x 2.2 nF C0G -> follower -> x-2.13 -> OUT (unity); sample on each rising TRIG edge (pulse 35 us or more)
